description.en: This ontology describes forest fire detection observations including image, audio, and weather data.

comments.en: Ontology for forest fire detection & observation (image, audio, weather). Root class: ForestFire. Designed for extensibility.

abstract.value: The Forest Fire Ontology (FFONTO) is designed to integrate multi-modal sensor data for early fire detection. It serves as an extensible framework with 'ForestFire' as the root class, incorporating concepts for visual detection, audio monitoring, and environmental conditions.
